title: Next greater element in a circular array
statement: For each element of a circular array (the end wraps to the start), return the first strictly greater element found going forward, or −1.
hints: Only push indices during the first pass; the second pass only resolves.

solution.explanation: Iterate i from 0 to 2n − 1 over nums[i mod n], resolving waiting indices with a monotonic stack; push only during the first pass so nothing waits for itself twice. Each index is pushed once and popped at most once.
